frozenInputs.documentationDescendant: Release receipts retain capture-time whole-repository dirty fingerprints. Final documentation-only edits do not alter any of the 821 frozen executable/test/build inputs; root manifest, root pin, committed dependency pins and original runtime are checked independently. The original receipt is not relabeled as a build of the final documentation descendant, and no performance requalification follows from documentation.

failedImpairedDuplex.decision: Ten candidate/candidate impaired hybrid native processes fail with duplicateOrLate; one fresh original-runtime process reproduces the same error. Excluded from qualified populations. Process groups reaped and UDP closure logged; native success, decoded accounting and joined media/DAVE closure not established. Stage 9 packet/pacing investigation remains open.

rejectedDuplexCapture.qualification: Ten native processes completed, but the generic comparison rejected the supervisor profile name as participant policy. Retained as rejected evidence and excluded from qualified populations. A separate corrected capture declares supervisor standard and actual attributed participant profiles; strict participant identity checks are retained.

localArtifacts.retention: Ignored .build/performance-phase8 evidence is retained locally; no upload, CI dispatch, push, publication, deployment or live Discord qualification.

integrity.populationChecks: Complete native/common populations verified by the retained analyzer; media counts describe batches, while local duplex deadlines remain directly observed.

limitations: Local UDP/synthetic signaling only; device/acoustic/live qualification open.
Native legacy p99 scalar is retained in native reports only; common p99 remains unqualified for sparse populations.
Child intervals overlap tick; no sum or subtraction of percentiles.

Apple cross-SDK emission is compile evidence; hardware/render/routing/acoustic and other-platform runtime qualification remain separate.

retainedDecisions: No public API, product dependency, filter design, lookahead, clipping or endpoint-extension change.
Immutable plans are shared safely by value copies; audio histories and lifecycle remain independent.
PCM FIFO and Apple capture mailbox implementations remain unchanged after depth investigation.
Codec FFT and transactional scratch ownership remain unchanged; CPU samples do not establish allocation counts.
Construction, continuous processing, final flushing, queue occupancy and paced duplex retain separate populations.

integrity.populationChecks: Complete native/common populations verified by the retained analyzer; media counts describe batches, while local duplex deadlines remain directly observed.

limitations: Informational local fresh-process observations on an uncontrolled host; no numerical acceptance gate.
Each reported mean is one process's exact timed sum divided by completed wrapper calls.
Batch quantile bounds describe complete per-process batch populations; process populations are never pooled.
Regular/irregular chunk calls admit differing frame counts; endpoint percentiles are not additive.
Process CPU includes population setup/oracles/cleanup; lifetime peak RSS includes startup and warmup.
Optional allocator gauges describe their explicit owner/time scope and are not cumulative allocation events.

runtimeBoundaryNotes: Media means use each process's exact timed sum divided by its successful wrapper calls. Histograms and tails describe batches, and process populations are never pooled.
Five independent no-change pairs and five alternating original/candidate pairs are descriptive observations on an unreserved local host; no numerical gate is promoted.
Constructor, process and finish percentiles are separate and cannot be added or subtracted to reconstruct an unobserved stream endpoint.
Regular and irregular process calls admit different source frame counts; per-call means are not an equal-byte chunk comparison.
PCM queue calls include two public actor hops, bounded result retention and FIFO work at fixed occupancy; these observations do not isolate Apple lock residence or producer/consumer contention.

Process CPU and RSS retain their actual process/peak/current scopes, including setup, oracles and cleanup. Optional media allocator snapshot fields are empty on this host; RSS does not count cumulative allocation events.
CPU samples are separate diagnostic processes, not timing comparison populations or an allocation-event profile.

Qualified local duplex uses actual unimpaired localhost UDP and paced software media with observed processing/schedule misses. Failed impaired hybrid controls are retained separately and establish no performance or impairment qualification. No device or live Discord session is exercised.
Zero media-batch deadline misses describes an unscheduled batch workload; local duplex misses remain visible in their own native/common reports.
selectedChange: Bounded immutable rational-rate FIR phase plans retain raw coefficients and normalization sums, preserving the original coefficient arithmetic and increasing-tap reduction order. Complete periods use at most 262144 bytes of Double payload; identity conversion and costly periods retain no coefficient plan and keep the bounded direct evaluator.
